collectItem(int, int) - Method in interface net.canarymod.api.factory.PacketFactory
Creates a CollectItem Packet

Sent by the server when someone picks up an item lying on the ground - its sole purpose appears to be the animation of the item flying towards you.
It doesn't destroy the entity in the client memory (0x1D does that), and it doesn't add it to your inventory (0x67 does that).
The server only checks for items to be picked up after each Player Position and Player Position & Look packet sent by the client.

entityRelativeMove(int, byte, byte, byte) - Method in interface net.canarymod.api.factory.PacketFactory
Creates a EntityRelativeMove Packet

This packet is sent by the server when an entity moves less then 4 blocks; if an entity moves more than 4 blocks Entity Teleport should be sent instead.
This packet allows at most four blocks movement in any direction, because byte range is from -128 to 127.
Movement is an offset of Absolute Int; to convert relative move to block coordinate offset, divide by 32.

load(HashMap<String, Object>) - Method in class net.canarymod.database.DataAccess
Load a Data set into this DataAccess object
load(DataAccess, Map<String, Object>) - Method in class net.canarymod.database.Database
This method will fill your DataAccess object with the first data set from database, that matches the given values in the given fields.
For instance if you pass String[] {"score", "name"}
with respective values Object[] {130, "damagefilter"},
Canary will look in the database for records where score=130 and name=damagefilter.
Canary will only look in the table with the name you have set in your AccessObject
